values.description: BACK_URL for TEST_ENV=vcst. Never hardcode this in a request.
camelCase-only. Omitting it returns 400 user_cannot_login_in_store on VALID credentials, which masks the org error being tested.
@td(MULTI_ORG_TF_BR.email) — the BACKEND-lane fixture. Reserved: a frontend-lane run must never authenticate as this account (both lanes mutate the same OrganizationMembership rows).
DELIBERATELY EMPTY — never commit a credential. Supply at run time: newman ... --env-var "b2bUserPassword=$DEFAULT_TEST_PASSWORD". Resolve it from .env.local via process.env, never from a literal.
@td(MULTI_ORG_TF_BR.org_techflow_id) — AGENT-TEST-Org-TechFlow. The NON-ACTIVE org on this account, and the one seed:membership-lock --state V2 locks.

@td(MULTI_ORG_TF_BR.org_buildright_id) — AGENT-TEST-Org-BuildRight. The ACTIVE org. A prior run inverted these two in 11 case bindings and every gate still passed, because a resolving @td() says nothing about whether it names the right entity.

@td(ORG_REP_ONLY.platform_id) — a real organization this account holds NO membership in. Request 1 asserts it is absent from organizationsIds; if you change it, that guard re-verifies the claim rather than trusting this comment. Blank it out to SKIP request 6 with a stated reason instead of silently passing.
Populated by request 0's test script. Must start empty.
Injected at run time. Never stored.
@td(MULTI_ORG_TF_BR.userId) — the SECURITY-ACCOUNT user id, not the contact id.
